request: Add two horizontal buttons to the front panel. One above existing one, the other below - all approximately equally distanced. Buttons should be copies of existing one.

actions.operation: Create one button by copying the existing button.
actions.relational_constraint: Place the copied button on the front panel above the existing button. Its distance from the existing button should be approximately equal to the distance between the existing button and the copied button placed below.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the existing button and the front panel in the CAD model; determine the applicable spacing measurement and placement distance from the approximately equal-spacing requirement.
steps: Localize the source feature as section S09, Upper horizontal control slot. The source button is the single elongated horizontal rounded-rectangular control visible to the left of the rotary dial in the top and top-right isometric views.

Use all source-button faces to preserve the complete geometry: left rounded end 0048 (FACE 419), upper wall 0049 (FACE 420), lower or seating face 0050 (FACE 421), right rounded end 0051 (FACE 422), lower wall 0052 (FACE 423), and visible top face 0053 (FACE 424).

Localize the supporting control-deck geometry in section S02, Main U-frame chassis. Use upper bay roof or upper control-deck face 0009 (FACE 63) as the placement reference. Do not use S01, because the multiview images show S01 as the separate large black end panel with four corner pads and no horizontal control button.

Create a datum plane coincident with, or locally tangent to, host face 0009. Establish a local coordinate system with its normal aligned to the host-face normal, its horizontal axis parallel to the long axis of the existing S09 button, and its vertical placement axis perpendicular to that long axis within the control-deck plane.

Measure the existing button centroid, overall length, overall width, end radius, body thickness, and normal stand-off from face 0009. Retain these values without scaling so the new button is an exact geometric copy.

Define a common center-to-center pitch P along the local vertical placement axis. Select P from the available clear control-deck area so that both future copies remain entirely on face 0009 and maintain clearance from the chassis edge, rotary dial S07, dial scale and markers S10, and other controls.
Copy the complete S09 solid or linked component body, preserving its horizontal orientation, end blends, wall geometry, thickness, color or appearance, and normal offset from face 0009.

Translate the copied button from the source centroid by +P along the local vertical placement axis, corresponding to the visually upper position in the top control-deck view. Do not rotate the copied body.

If the source button is generated parametrically rather than stored as a reusable body, create a sketch on the datum plane, project the source outline, reproduce the straight parallel sides and semicircular or blended ends, fully constrain it to the source dimensions, and locate its center at +P from the existing button center.

Extrude the copied sketch normal to face 0009 using the same depth and direction as the existing button. Reproduce any source seating recess, top-face offset, fillets, or chamfers so faces 0048 through 0053 are functionally duplicated.

Keep the new button as a separate control solid or component unless the existing S09 button is fused to the chassis. If the existing control includes a corresponding panel aperture or seating pocket, copy that dependent cut into S02 at the same translated position while preserving the perimeter support material.

Verify that the new upper button does not intersect S07, S10, the enclosure boundary, or internal support geometry. Confirm that its major axis remains parallel to the existing horizontal button and that its normal seating relationship to face 0009 matches S09.

actions.operation: Create one button by copying the existing button.
actions.relational_constraint: Place the copied button on the front panel below the existing button. Its distance from the existing button should be approximately equal to the distance between the existing button and the copied button placed above.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the existing button and the front panel in the CAD model; determine the applicable spacing measurement and placement distance from the approximately equal-spacing requirement.
steps: Use section S09, Upper horizontal control slot, as the source button and section S02, Main U-frame chassis, as the supporting control-deck section.

Reference the complete source geometry through faces 0048 to 0053, corresponding to FACE 419 through FACE 424. Use host face 0009 (FACE 63) to control the new button's seating plane and normal direction.

Reuse the same datum plane and local coordinate system established for the upper copy. The local horizontal axis must remain parallel to the long axis of the existing S09 button, while the vertical placement axis defines the above-and-below arrangement visible in the top view.

Reuse the same center-to-center pitch P selected for the upper copy. Because all three buttons have identical copied dimensions, equal center-to-center pitch also produces equal edge-to-edge clear spacing.
Copy the complete S09 solid or linked component body again, retaining the existing length, width, rounded ends, wall profiles, top face, lower seating face, thickness, appearance, and orientation.

Translate this second copy from the existing-button centroid by -P along the local vertical placement axis, corresponding to the visually lower position in the top control-deck view. Apply no rotation or scaling.

If reconstruction is required, sketch the same projected rounded-slot profile on the datum plane, constrain it to the source S09 dimensions, and constrain its center to lie on the same vertical construction line as the existing and upper buttons at an offset of -P.
Extrude the profile normal to host face 0009 using the same extent, direction, and stand-off as the existing button. Apply matching end blends, edge fillets, chamfers, recesses, or seating details.

If the source control requires an opening or clearance pocket in S02, duplicate the associated cut at the lower location using the same profile and depth. Avoid cutting unrelated chassis faces or the perforated support panel S06.
Apply an equal-spacing constraint or a centered three-instance linear-pattern constraint so the upper copy, original S09 button, and lower copy have collinear centers and identical pitch P.
Confirm that all three controls remain horizontal, parallel, coplanar relative to the control-deck surface, and approximately equally spaced.

Run interference and minimum-clearance checks against the dial S07, marker set S10, chassis edges, internal support panel S06, and neighboring controls. Adjust only the common pitch P if clearance is inadequate; do not alter the copied button geometry.
Retain the two added buttons as new control sections or component instances derived from S09, with S09 itself unchanged and S02 modified only if matching mounting apertures or recesses are required.

intention: Create a vertically arranged group of three identical horizontal controls on the upper front control deck.
Preserve the geometry and orientation of the existing S09 horizontal button while placing one copy on each side at a common pitch.
Maintain a visually balanced, approximately equal spacing without interfering with the rotary dial, scale markers, enclosure edges, or internal support geometry.
